messages:
elaine: Heads-up team  quick ops for the launch + companion webinar next week. We need a tight SEO action list: keyword mapping, Event JSON-LD, internal linking plan (blog -> landing -> webinar), and redirects for legacy pages. Who's in?

maria: I can run the keyword map and write 2 meta title variations per page. Thinking buckets: awareness (LLM inference), technical (low-latency serving), economic (reduce inference cost). Will post a spreadsheet with priority cols.

devon: I9ll own redirects and canonical decisions. Please post the legacy paths. I9ll prepare nginx rules and a checklist for CDN purge.

sam: Internal linking & CTAs. I'll add contextual anchors from the launch blog to the product landing and embed a mid-article link to the benchmark narrative. Also will add UTM parameters for webinar CTAs.

tyler: For infra, deploy window is 22:00 PT for redirects + purges. Need final rewrite rules by 20:00 PT so I can stage. Confirm if any pages need server-side canonical headers.

elaine: Minimal seed mapping (we'll expand):
- /product/inference -> keyword target: inference platform
- /webinars/reliable-llm -> target: low-latency LLM serving
- benchmark narrative landing -> target: reduce per-token inference cost

seo-bot: crawl alert: duplicate titles detected at /old-launch/overview and /blog/2023-launch. Recommend 301 from /old-launch/* -> /product/inference and rel=canonical on blog pointing to landing. Also missing Event schema on /webinars/reliable-llm.

maria: Event JSON-LD draft  please add to the webinar page head and update startDate/URL as needed: 
```
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Reliable LLM at Scale: Launch + Benchmarks",
  "startDate": "2025-05-14T17:00:00Z",
  "location": { "@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.inference/webinars/reliable-llm" },
  "offers": { "@type": "Offer", "url": "https://redwood.inference/webinars/reliable-llm/register" }
}
</script>
```
This should enable SERP event features and registration CTA link.

devon: Draft nginx rewrite rules (will deliver final by 20:00 PT):
```
rewrite ^/old-launch/(.*)$ /product/inference permanent;
rewrite ^/legacy-webinar/(.*)$ /webinars/reliable-llm permanent;
rewrite ^/docs/v1/(.*)$ /docs/$1 permanent;
```
I'll also add rel=canonical meta updates where appropriate.

sam: HubSpot form snippet for the webinar landing - include hidden UTM fields so leads route cleanly: 
```
<input type="hidden" name="utm_source" value="webinar">
<input type="hidden" name="campaign" value="launch_reliable_llm_2025-05">
```
Make sure form field mapping sends campaign into the contact property.

tyler: On deploy day I'll purge CDN for these paths: /old-launch/*, /blog/2023-launch, /webinars/reliable-llm, /product/inference. Tag me in the PR for staging.

elaine: Deadlines:
- Keyword spreadsheet + meta/title drafts: @maria by EOD today
- Redirect rules: @devon by 20:00 PT
- Redirect deploy & CDN purge: @tyler 22:00 PT deploy window
- Internal linking + CTA/UTM wiring: @sam by EOD today
- Add Event JSON-LD: @maria or eng by EOD

maria: I'll also paste top-3 competitor SERP titles for each bucket once I finish the audit.

seo-bot: scheduled follow-up crawl at 06:00 PT tomorrow to verify 301s, canonical headers, and presence of Event schema. Will post results in this thread.

elaine: Great work. Keep this thread as the single source for any final legacy paths. If you find more, drop them here and @devon will roll them into the rule set. :sparkles:
